# STM32 SVD source

`stm32f411.svd` comes from
[tinygo-org/stm32-svd](https://github.com/tinygo-org/stm32-svd), not directly
from ST's raw distribution. The files incorporate the `stm32-rs` corrections
to vendor SVD data.

The underlying device descriptions remain subject to ST's license. The
`stm32-rs` patches are distributed under Apache-2.0/MIT terms; see the source
repository for the complete provenance and license texts.
